sentences.text: The window is open and light comes in.
Please close the window; it is cold.
There is one big window in the room.
I have the key in my pocket.
I lost the door key.
I got a new key at the bank.
The phone does not work today.
The phone is lying in the bag.
The new phone is very fast.
I use a computer at work.
A new computer is expensive.
The computer is off now.
In the evening we watch television.
The television is very loud.
The television is showing a new film.
The radio is playing a song.
I turned on the radio in the morning.
The radio is talking about the weather.
The bag is heavy today.
The bag is full of books.
I put the empty bag on the floor.
The clothes are already clean.
Winter clothes are warm.
I washed the clothes today.
The shoes are wet from the rain.
The new shoes are comfortable.
I put the shoes by the door.
I have a hat on my head.
I bought a black hat at the market.
The hat flew away in the wind.
The shirt is white and clean.
I am wearing a blue shirt today.
The shirt is too small.
The pants are black for work.
The new pants are long.
The pants are on the drying rack now.
The dress is beautiful at the party.
I gave a red dress to mother.
The dress is short for me.
The jacket is warm in winter.
In cold weather I wear a jacket.
The jacket is on the hanger in the hallway.
There is not enough money today.
I spent a lot of money at the market.
I have money in the wallet.
I have one lari left in the shop.
I need two lari for bread.
I withdrew ten lari at the bank.
I already have a bus ticket.
Let's buy a theater ticket together.
The ticket is very expensive.
The map shows us the city road.
In the museum the map is on the wall.
A tourist is holding a map in hand.
The gift for mother is beautiful.
I gave a gift on the birthday.
A small gift is in the box.
The box is lying in the corner.

sentences.target: გავხსენი ყუთი და შიგნით სათამაშო იყო.
sentences.text: I opened the box and inside there was a toy.
The big box is heavy.
Soap is needed for the hands.
New soap is in the bathroom.
The soap is scented and white.
The towel is wet after the shower.
Take a clean towel from the shelf.
The towel is blue and soft.
The mirror is hanging on the wall.
In the morning I look in the mirror.
I have a small mirror in the bag.
The cup is full of tea.
Please pass me a cup.
The cup fell from the table.
The plate is empty at dinner.
I have hot soup on the plate.
I placed the plate on the dining table.
I need a spoon for the soup.
The child is holding a spoon.
The spoon is stainless and clean.
I use a knife to cut bread.
Careful, the knife is sharp.
The knife is lying in the kitchen.
I have a fork with the salad.
At dinner we need a fork and a knife.
The fork fell on the floor.
The lesson is interesting today.
The short lesson has already ended.
Tomorrow the lesson will start early.
I have a lot of work today.
This matter is simple for me.
Work at the office is going well.
The homework is difficult today.
I finished the homework for the evening.
The teacher is checking the homework.
The exam is tomorrow morning.
The exam was hard, but I passed.
The exam is soon and I am preparing.
I asked the teacher a question.
This question is simple.
I did not understand the last question.
The answer is correct and short.
I wrote my answer in the notebook.
I do not know the answer yet.
The house number is ten.
I wrote down the phone number.
The room number is three.
The first letter of the alphabet is a.
I wrote this letter neatly.
The last letter in the notebook is big.
I love the Georgian language.
I study Georgian in class.
I already understand a little Georgian.
The English conversation is going slowly.
We are watching an English film.
English is important at school.
History is an interesting subject.
We study Georgian history in class.
In the history book there are many stories.
Math is difficult today.
Math is full of numbers.
I like math at school.
The music in the room is loud.
I love quiet music in the evening.
I hear music from the radio.
The picture is hanging on the wall.
The child's picture is very beautiful.
I saw a picture in the museum.
I took a photo in the park.
The family photo is on the shelf.
An old photo is in the album.
The children really like the game.
In the evening we have a card game.
The new game is interesting.
I wrote a letter for a friend.
I sent the letter today.
A long letter arrived from the post office.
A message arrived on the phone.
I wrote a short message.
I have not read the message yet.
I read the news in the newspaper.
Good news came today.
I hear the news from the radio.
The document needs a signature.
An important document is in the bag.
I put the document in the folder.
The paper is white and clean.
The project needs paper.
The paper in the notebook is blank.
The second page is in the book.
This page is still blank.
I already read the last page.
